entities.summary: Ella Shelton is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Toronto Sceptres of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL), and member of the Canadian national team. She was drafted fourth overall in the 2023 PWHL draft by the New York Sirens.
